text:
Mia Chen: Heads up - I'm starting a small canary for the new prompt redaction heuristics this afternoon. Want ops + platform eyes on sampling & quota impact before we flip.

Alex P.: +1. What are the heuristics again? partial redact, keep leading tokens, hash rest?

Mia Chen: Roughly: keep prompt metadata, redact free-text user prompts using token-aware boundaries, then store a keyed HMAC for provenance. Also want an opt-in temporary unmask flow for support with TTL.

Rajesh: How will this affect telemetry? need tagging so dashboards can distinguish redacted vs unredacted traffic (and redaction version).

Mia Chen: plan is to add envelope fields in logs: "pii_redaction=prompt_v2" and "redact_hash_v=1" plus "unmask_ttl" when set. Also attach "sample_rate" for sampled captures. Example envelope: ```{"pii_redaction":"prompt_v2","redact_hash_v":"h1","sample_rate":0.01,"unmask_ttl":"1h"}```

Diane: small ask: console needs a visible badge that indicates whether a request was redacted and which policy applied. Otherwise support will be chasing ghosts.

Sam: for temporary unmask flow, ensure audit trail + one-click revoke. Can't leave unmask tokens around. TTL short and revokable.

Alex P.: quota math - if we enable sampled capture for 1% of requests during canary, what's extra tokens/storage? rough numbers please.

Mia Chen: quick calc: current host requests ~120k/day. 1% sampled => 1.2k captures/day. avg capture size 12KB => ~14MB/day. Add HMACs & metadata => ~16MB/day. trivial for short canary, but watch replay spikes.

Rajesh: ops: can we grant short-term burst quota to the canary org for 48h?

ops-bot: @ops:quota-request canary-org +burst 48h requested by mia.chen - awaiting approval.

Diane: UX rollout plan: add console toggle (admins only) to switch between redact v1 and v2 per tenant. Default v1. Canary tenants opt into v2. Need telemetry events for toggles.

Sam: Security checklist: KMS keys for HMAC should be tenant-scoped where possible; otherwise require strong access auditing. Require manual approval for unmask enable.

Alex P.: sampling & privacy: if tenant opts out of telemetry, sampled captures must honor that. Make consent a hard requirement in code path.

Mia Chen: agreed. PR will include details. plan: canary rollout to 5 tenants at 13:00 UTC, sample_rate=0.01, unmask disabled initially; enable only via manual support ticket.

Rajesh: add a dashboard panel that shows: redaction-policy, sample-rate, sampled-capture-count, avg-capture-size, unmask-requests. even a simple heatmap will help.

Diane: I'll mock the console badge + dashboard widgets this morning. Alex, can we include a saved query for SLOs to show latency diff?

Alex P.: yes. perf estimate: redaction adds ~3-6ms CPU per request for token parsing. watch p50/p99.

ops-bot: @ops:quota-request canary-org +burst 48h - approved by ops-team at 1746167810.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for redaction-service at 1746167811 by mia.chen - see /deploys/1746167811 for logs.

Mia Chen: thanks. if anything odd shows (latency or unexpectedly high sampled captures), ping me and we'll roll back. planning to capture minimal fields only.

Sam: noted. will follow up with audit flow and revoke endpoint docs.

Rajesh: analytics: store minimal provenance row referencing HMAC key id and redact version so we can audit without storing PII.

Diane: moving UX follow-up to a separate thread. good to go for canary once deploy completes. :thumbsup:

Alex P.: ack. monitoring alerts going live for redaction-canary p99 > 300ms and sample_count > 2k/day.

Mia Chen: closing loop - will post a canary report in #eng-platform in 24h.
